camera.framing_intent: Show the complete layered route, positive clearance and supported ending; keep decisive interactions in a readable shot.

ending.description: Keep the actor visible as it reaches a supported catch area; no offscreen parking or teleport reset.

events.measurement_required: Measure tangential speed and energy against the declared contact model. A camera movement is not object acceleration.
events.physical_cause: Gravity-driven descent on a supported ramp; target timing is a design request, not a measurement.

events.measurement_required: Contact-time interval, surface normal and pre/post velocities from evaluated states; no position/velocity injection.
events.physical_cause: An oblique fixed surface redirects the incoming physical trajectory.

events.measurement_required: Bracket the closest approach and certify a positive surface gap across the entire approach/separation interval, with numerical uncertainty; inspect camera readability.
events.physical_cause: The outgoing trajectory passes a static post with positive separation before entering a supported ending.

mechanics.actuation_model: Unpowered gravity-driven actor; no velocity/position injection to meet target times.
mechanics.contact_model: Existing sphere/fixed-OBB contact model; candidate contact certificates required.
limitations: This is an unmeasured authoring target, not solved geometry.
No coupled dynamic-body collisions or adhesion.
mechanics.material_model: Declared restitution, friction and rolling-resistance parameters must be chosen and calibrated before solving.
mechanics.scope: One dynamic sphere against fixed OBB colliders; no moving-contact obstacles or coupled bodies.

music_hints.intent: Propose tension and space around the measured near miss; no impact Foley. Preserve the existing voice and original editable score.
Propose a bounded contour from signed evaluated motion after physical validation and exact plan approval.

reference_lessons.evidence_note: Consumed supplied text notes only. Their author inspected sparse frames; this run did not view or certify the referenced media.
reference_lessons.lesson: Transfer layered, legible routing and visible support; preserve sparse events.

route_stages.entry_intent: Supported release at the upper ramp.
route_stages.mechanism: Gravity-driven descent on a fixed ramp.

route_stages.entry_intent: Incoming trajectory reaches the oblique surface.
route_stages.mechanism: One sphere contacts a fixed OBB.

route_stages.exit_intent: Separate from the post toward the catch area.
route_stages.mechanism: Unpowered travel past a fixed clearance obstacle.

route_stages.exit_intent: Remain supported and visible at the endpoint.
route_stages.mechanism: Dissipation/contact under the declared material model.

support_contacts.evidence_required: Retain raw support-contact intervals and evaluate physical support; do not emit repeated impact events.
Measure supported settling without freezing a free body.
